topic: ELEMIS Pro Collagen Cleansing Balm vs medicube Facial Cleanser Zero Pore
angle: Head-to-head: which of these two is the smarter buy for most people?

reviews.title: ELEMIS Pro Collagen Cleansing Balm
pros: Dissolves stubborn waterproof mascara and long-wear foundation in under 60 seconds with zero harsh rubbing
Contains padina pavonica, optimega, and chia seed oil — a genuinely hydrating formula that leaves skin soft, not stripped
One tub lasts 3–4 months with daily use, making the $61 price point more reasonable per application
